seoTitle: Expense Report Builder With VAT and CSV Export
metaDescription: Itemize business expenses with category and VAT, get totals by category and rate, and copy the CSV. Free and private.
intro: Turns pasted expense lines into totals by category and VAT rate, plus CSV.
why:
Expense claims need net, VAT and gross per line and a summary by category. Paste CSV lines of date, category, description, amount and VAT percent.

Choose whether amounts include VAT. Whether VAT is deductible depends on national rules for meals, cars and similar items.
howTo: Paste one expense per line as CSV.
Copy the totals or the CSV.
